title: Game of Thrones
description: Nine noble families fight for control over the lands of Westeros, while an ancient enemy returns after being dormant for millennia.

title: The Sopranos
description: New Jersey mob boss Tony Soprano deals with the problems of his illegal empire and his family while seeking therapy.

title: Breaking Bad
description: A high school chemistry teacher turned meth cook partners with a former student to produce crystal meth.

title: Dexter
description: A forensic analyst and serial killer named Dexter Morgan hides his murderous nature while helping law enforcement.

title: True Detective
description: Two detectives hunt a serial killer while dealing with their personal demons in Louisiana.

title: Boardwalk Empire
description: An Atlantic City gangster pursues wealth and power in Prohibition-era New Jersey.

title: The Wire
description: A gritty drama depicting the lives of both law enforcement and criminals in Baltimore.

title: Westworld
description: In a futuristic Western theme park populated by android hosts, guests can live out their fantasies.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
description: A woman is forced into servitude in a dystopian future where fertility rates have collapsed.

title: Orange Is the New Black
description: A white woman is convicted and sent to a prison where she encounters different types of women inmates.
